**🗄️ Data Integrity & Integration** | **🟠 Major** | **🏗️ Heavy lift**

**Preserve content-block order when accumulating tool calls.**

If Nova emits text between two tool calls, both accumulators retain the tool calls in `tool_blocks` but merge all text into `outputText`. The Amazon span mapper then places that merged text before both tool calls. The exported message no longer represents the response order. Retain ordered content blocks, using `contentBlockIndex` to associate deltas with their blocks, and emit parts in that order. AWS documents multiple tool calls and content-block indices. ([docs.aws.amazon.com](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/nova/latest/userguide/tool-use-invocation.html?utm_source=openai))

  


Also applies to: 200-202
